heading: Probability
text: Logistic regression estimates class probabilities. A threshold converts probabilities into predicted classes.

heading: Sigmoid
text: The sigmoid maps a real-valued score into a probability between zero and one.

heading: Errors
text: A false positive predicts positive for an actually negative case. A false negative predicts negative for an actually positive case.

heading: Metrics
text: Precision is true positives divided by all predicted positives. Recall is true positives divided by all actual positives.

heading: Regularization
text: Regularization penalizes model coefficients to reduce overfitting. L1 can shrink coefficients to zero; L2 shrinks them toward zero.
